components.rationale: The SUPPORT states live alternatives or explicitly says the current evidence does not distinguish them. Resolving the named alternatives at the stated evidence scope preserves the contrast without inventing an outcome. Reviewed closed bundle: P001 SUPPORT.

The SUPPORT bundle states both outcome-to-alternative preferences, including their conditions. Cited context supplies the selected operation and live alternatives where these occupy separate spans. Preference is retained as preference, without an assertion of certainty. Reviewed closed bundle: P002 SUPPORT, P003 SUPPORT, P001 CONTEXT.
